Railway Oval | Railway Oval is a multi-use stadium in Kingston, Jamaica.  It is used mostly for football matches.  It serves as a home ground of Tivoli Gardens F.C..  The stadium holds 5,000 people.  In 1987 124,000 spectators attended a Jamaican cup match with Tivoli Gardens in the stadium.
